description: The driver arrived at the pickup point and waited for 7 minutes. The rider did not appear or respond to messages. A SGD 8 cancellation charge was applied and the rider disputes it.

trip.driver_reported_reason: Rider was a no-show; driver waited 7 minutes and cancelled

chat_log.message: Hi, I've arrived at NEX Shopping Mall. I'm at the pickup point near the taxi stand.
I'm still waiting at the pickup point. Please come when you're ready.
I've waited 7 minutes and you haven't arrived. I'll have to cancel the trip and a cancellation fee will apply.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver GPS confirms the driver arrived at the pickup point and remained stationary for 7 minutes. The driver sent two messages to the rider who neither appeared nor responded. The SGD 8 cancellation charge is justified.
